We are equally happy to come to you. Meeting on the property lets us experience the hotel first-hand and understand the stay from your guest’s point of view.

NSW & ACTWe typically need 48 hours’ notice to meet at your property.

Other statesWe typically ask for one week’s notice, then we will fly to you.
